comment: 12 needle queries for the eval harness. Seeded from docs/findings.md template + Decision 17 capability matrix. Editable — the user can adjust SQL filters as the metadata schema fills in.

needles.query_text: unprotected left turn with pedestrian in the crosswalk
needles.notes: Hybrid SQL+vector. BDD100K excluded — no ego-pose for turn detection.

needles.query_text: near miss with pedestrian, close braking
needles.notes: Needs LiDAR-derived perception distance. Skipped on BDD100K.
Waymo public release lacks IMU — column NULL. nuScenes + AV2 have it.

needles.query_text: cyclist weaving between lanes in traffic
needles.notes: All datasets count cyclists; vector captures the weaving motion semantic.

needles.query_text: construction zone with cones and workers
needles.notes: Pure vector. No structured label for 'construction' in any of our metadata.
Waymo: time_of_day rough only. BDD100K + nuScenes have explicit night labels.

needles.query_text: school bus with stop arm extended
emergency vehicle with lights, ambulance or police
needles.notes: Pure vector. Lighting/markings are visual not structured.
Waymo curated out jaywalking — BDD100K + nuScenes have it natively.
Image→image. Seed: Waymo FRONT camera, device 10082223140073588526_6140_000_6160_000 (SF segment). Tests DINOv2 (image-only model) head-to-head with SigLIP/CLIP on a similarity-only query.

needles.query_text: wet road, reflections from streetlights at night
needles.notes: BDD100K + nuScenes have weather + time-of-day. Waymo lacks weather column.

Image→image. Seed: BDD100K dashcam (bdd100k_train). Active-learning eval-set growth use case: pick one labeled frame, find more like it. Cross-dataset story: do we find Waymo lookalikes from a BDD seed?
